policy: All weights, caches, downloads, temporary conversion files and outputs must stay on this mounted dedicated external volume; no internal or X9 fallback. No existing files will be moved or deleted.
interpretation: Source payload sizes are exact metadata values. GGUF/log sizes are unmeasured conservative allocations, never claimed exact; exceeding a reservation requires a new reviewed budget before further writes.

cache_search.internal_model_cache: refs/main only (40 bytes), no matching snapshot
cache_search.note: Bounded filename inventory found no selected checkpoint; no payload is credited without hash verification. This is not a full-volume content hash search.

log_reservation_note: 8 GiB reserves space for full driver and independent server evidence. Actual schema/record size remains unmeasured; the future runner must record incremental food events and fail explicitly before exceeding reserved space, never silently truncate or discard records.
